links.outcome: Cross-dataset performance change after GRPO training (CheXpert vs NIH)
links.effect: GRPO improved CheXpert performance by 23% (macro-F1 = 0.346) but degraded NIH cross-dataset performance by 19%.
links.quote: Evaluations on CheXpert and NIH benchmarks reveal a fundamental tension: GRPO recovers in-distribution performance (23% improvement on CheXpert, macro-F1 = 0.346) but degrades cross-dataset transferability (19% drop on NIH).

unlisted_practices: Curated supervised fine-tuning preferred over aggressive reinforcement learning to improve cross-institution robustness
Structured reasoning scaffolds for vision-language models

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating RL vs SFT fine-tuning strategies for vision-language models on chest X-ray reasoning datasets, demonstrating out-of-distribution generalization failures.
